evidence_scope: Executable host Java/Robolectric regressions, static source review, debug assembly, and fork readback. No Android device, application UI, native parsing/rendering, or official-build reproduction is claimed.
summary: Reserve -1 for no internal destination in both PageView.hitLink overloads and accept page >= 0 in ReaderView.onSingleTapUp. This lets an internal link to zero-based page 0 navigate and record history without turning missed/external links into first-page navigation.

limitations: The reproduced defect is the simplified viewer's Java tap-dispatch behavior at the pinned base, not a claim about every MuPDF app, version, or official Play build.
Robolectric uses API 33 with synthetic document/link JNI substitutes and a renderer-free PageAdapter. Host tests do not parse the lab's navigation.pdf or launch DocumentActivity or external apps.

The complete original green/build shell invocations and process exit codes were not retained. The records distinguish normalized reproduction commands from observed JUnit results and Gradle summaries.

Only the focused suite and debug assembly are evidenced. Device instrumentation, full CI/lint, native rebuilding, ABI coverage, geometry/zoom edge cases, and downstream library consumers were not comprehensively tested.
The public hitLink methods change their no-internal-destination value from 0 to -1. Downstream callers outside the inspected viewer source were not inventoried.
The two interrupted push attempts had different outcomes: the first succeeded and an overlapping duplicate was rejected. A subsequent remote readback confirms the intended commit.
The contribution has not been submitted or merged upstream. The final runtime closeout records application/device A/B as not run.
